name: scRNA-seq clustering benchmark and parameter sensitivity analysis
description: Benchmarks single-cell RNA-seq clustering methods and analyzes their sensitivity to parameter choices across datasets.
evaluation_method: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) (also commonly reports NMI, silhouette, and clustering F1)
typical_sota_score: 0.4–0.9 (ARI, varies strongly by dataset and ground-truth resolution)
reputation: Moderately used in the single-cell bioinformatics community as a method-comparison and parameter-sensitivity reference for scRNA-seq clustering.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results strongly dependent on dataset preprocessing, batch effects and ground-truth annotations; sensitive to parameter choices so scores can vary widely across replicates and datasets.
